name: Traveling Merchants
description: Five distinct merchant NPCs out ON THE ROUTES - a Peddler (supplies), a Digger (fossils/stones), a Herbalist (vitamins/candy), a Techie (TMs), and a Tamer (rare Pokemon + curios). Each has its own sprite, personality, route pair, and patrol style. Locations and stock rotate on REAL-WORLD days. Spawned at runtime with real collision (mapOverview) - no map edits, no in-game clock needed.
